page.overview:
What is The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past?

The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past is the third main installment of , and the first and only title for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System, released in November 21, 1991 in Japan and April 13, 1992 in the United States, and few months later in United Kingdom & Ireland. After the controversial side-scrolling and RPG-like gameplay of , was a return to the overhead view and gameplay style of . One of the most influential titles of the series, this game introduced major new items to the franchise such as the Master Sword, and the concept of two different worlds (Light World and Dark World), which was revisited to an extent in with two separate time periods rather than the light and dark worlds. was re-released in 2002, on the Game Boy Advance, sharing a new multiplayer game called . The Japanese version of the game is known as The Legend of Zelda: Triforce of the Gods.

The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening on the Game Boy is the game's direct sequel, while A Link Between Worlds on the Nintendo 3DS is the indirect equivalent.

One day, a band of evil thieves managed to open the gateway to the Golden Land, where the mystical Triforce was hidden. Upon finding the sacred golden relic, the leader of the thieves, Ganondorf, slew his followers and claimed it as his own. Before long, dark power began to flow forth from the Sacred Realm. People were drawn into this darkness, and never heard from again. As a result, the King of Hyrule ordered the Seven Wise Men to seal the entrance to the Sacred Realm, now known as the Dark World. A great battle ensued—monsters poured into the Light World (Hyrule) from the sacred land and attacked the castle. The Knights of Hyrule defended the Sages during the great battle against evil, and, though most of them perished in the struggle, the sages were able to cast their seal, stopping the flow of darkness and trapping the evil demon king Ganon within. This battle became known as the Imprisoning War.

Once the conflicts against Ganon had ceased, Hyrule entered a time of peace which lasted for centuries, until one day, when unexplained catastrophes began to occur. Pestilence and drought ravaged the land. Thinking the recent disasters plaguing Hyrule were somehow linked to the sages' seal, the king investigated it, but found it to be intact. Desperate for answers, he offered rewards for anyone who could find the source of Hyrule's troubles.

Also known as: ALttP, Link to the Past.
